COMPUTER STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

5. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

7. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Central Processing Unit.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.

8. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.

9. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

10. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.

11. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.

12. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.

13. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

15. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.

16. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Program development 3.3 Identifiers and Operators 3.4 Control Structures 3.5 Dat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
